name: Torre PwC (Torre Sacyr Vallehermoso)

rights.note: Built 2004–2008 for Sacyr Vallehermoso (main contractor Sacyr); renamed Torre PwC in 2011. Hotel Eurostars Madrid Tower on floors 6–27.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q651643_torre_pwc.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Plan from OpenStreetMap (simplified to 0.1 m); the scaly double skin is one tilted pane per floor (3.8 m) and bay (about 2.4 m), staggered from floor to floor, bronze-grey with a little random variation, darker in the three fissures; the last two floors (restaurant) in lighter glass. Above 212 m the skin goes on as separate panels with sky between them (the open crown that hides the plant), tied by a ring beam; the plant is one grey block under the hexagonal deck at 236 m. The tower has no front: the fissure towards the Paseo de la Castellana (west, the hotel's address and entrance) is taken as the main façade. Simplified or omitted: the entrance canopy, the inner skin, the wind turbines and the logo. Uncertain: the exact height where the open crown starts and the shape of the plant inside it.
